thread:
alice: Seeing a 12-17% P99 latency bump on prod after the 'max_token_budget' tweak on the batcher. Happened around 04:20 PT. @bhavik can you take a look? suspiciously correlated with prefix-cache hit ratio > 60%.
bhavik: On it. Which pool? dedicated-prod-eu1?
alice: yes, dedicated-prod-eu1, model: redwood-7b-c4 q4_0. Also noticed kernel selection flip to slower GEMM path when avg seq_len > 512.
carla: Could be packer turning on 'favor_cache_hits' and packing many short requests with big prefixes => token budget per batch inflated. Pack logs?
alice: pasted pack logs below:
```txt
batch_id=3187 pool=dedicated-prod-eu1 participants=12 tokens_requested=15480 cache_hits=9 avg_seq=78 token_budget=20480 pack_policy=favor_cache_hits
```
dave: If cache_hits are high, kv cache means less decode but more key memory; our kernel selector currently uses estimated decode_tokens to pick matmul kernel. With cached prefixes decode_tokens is lower but we weren't updating the kernel heuristic -> picks wide GEMM that's worse for short decode lengths.
eva: Means we need to feed 'effective_decode_len' into selector. Also queue policy might be allowing large batches because token_budget target still set to 20k.
bhavik: Quick experiment: lowered token_budget target to 12k on a canary host and toggled selector flag to use decode_tokens instead of seq_len for kernel sel. Results in 8% P99 improvement and 3% throughput loss.
alice: :thumbsup: good. Any regression on latency tail for requests with no cache hit?
bhavik: No, neutral. Regression before was only when cache hit ratio >50%.
carla: We should consider an admission control: if cache_hit_ratio > X, cap batch token_budget per-request to avoid packing too many prefixes together. Also tweak packer to prefer more requests rather than long virtual batch length.
dave: Agree. Proposed changes:
- add 'effective_decode_len' to kernel selector
- dynamic token budget: token_budget = base_budget * (1 - cache_hit_ratio * alpha)
- queue policy: prefer earliest_request when cache hits high
- add metric: pack_virtual_length and pack_kernel_choice

alice: Can you open a PR with perf test and flamegraph? I'll schedule a small canary roll tomorrow morning.
carla: Also flag: we saw one host with overflowed KV memory because we kept packing many unique prefixes; need eviction/backpressure.
infra-bot: deploybot: canary deploy queued for dedicated-prod-eu1, tag: cache-aware-pack-2026-03-18, ETA 06:00 PT
eva: I'll add a quick perf dashboard panel for cache_hit_ratio vs p99.
bhavik: I'll put the initial change behind runtime flag: runtime.pack.cache_aware_enabled and runtime.selector.use_effective_decode_len.
alice: Thanks team. Follow-ups: 1) PR link (bhavik), 2) canary results in this thread, 3) waterfall trace if any P99 persists.
